title: centropogon laciniatus
intro: Centropogon laciniatus, commonly known as the Split-leaved Centropogon, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's efficacy and potential side effects.
